rules.rule: Noto Sans is the typeface for every MoSJE property. No second family is introduced for display or accent.
Body text is left-aligned. Never justified, never centred for running paragraphs.
In tables: text left, numbers right, column headers centred.
No Hinglish. Write English or हिन्दी, each in its own script, each marked with lang.
One h1 per page, and heading order never skips a level.
Pick a role by the job it does, not by the size it happens to be — the tiers overlap.
Display carries presence; Headline carries document structure. Do not substitute one for the other.

The 21-role scale is the estate's implementation of DBIM §4's hierarchy — with three recorded deviations: headline sizes (40/32/28 against DBIM's 36/24/20), display leading below 1.2, and no size below 12px. See the deviation register.

Latin body sits at 1.5 line height; a Hindi block at any role takes the role's Latin leading plus a fifth of its size, rounded up to the 4px grid (body-1 16/28, headline-1 40/56) — the same size, more room, the same rhythm.
ALL-CAPS is never used for a sentence or paragraph — only 1–3 word overlines, and only in the label-3 role, which carries the +0.06em caps tracking.
Measure stays between 45 and 75 characters; body copy is capped rather than run full width.
Text spacing must survive user overrides of line height, word and letter spacing without clipping.
Body text ≥ 4.5:1 against its background; large text ≥ 3:1.
At 11px (label-3) treat 4.5:1 as a floor rather than a target, and avoid tinted fills behind it.
In dbim brand mode, text uses shade 1 or 2 of the key colour group.
Text resizes to 200% with no loss of content or function.
Content reflows at a 320px equivalent without two-dimensional scrolling.
Sizes are fluid between 360px and 1280px — no type breakpoints, and no role grows as the viewport shrinks.
Text-entry controls hold a hard 16px floor below 768px so iOS Safari does not trap the user zoomed in.
Nothing renders below 12px. label-3 is 12px; there is no 11px, 10px or 9px anywhere.
Every size is on the 16-step ramp and every line height on the 4px grid; leading rises as size falls, from 1.10 at display-1 to 1.5 at body.
Title, Body and Label are identical on both surfaces. Only Display and Headline are cut differently for the website and the portals.
Headings and titles are semibold (600); display is medium (500) on the Display cut; body is regular; labels are medium. 700 is inline emphasis and KPI numerals only; 800 and 900 do not exist.
Type is written through Heading and Text (or the text-<role> utilities). A raw size, leading, tracking or a stock Tailwind size utility fails the type gate.

$standards: The 19 typography rules, grouped as UX4G groups them, each tagged to the standard it comes from (DBIM / GIGW / SAMAVESH) so a reviewer can audit rather than trust. Editorial, like the specimens — a human owns the wording.
